A '''memory disc''',<ref name="Questal">''[[The Game Chambers of Questal]]''</ref> also known as a '''memory disk''', was a type of data storage medium.<ref name="Refugee">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The memory disc was first introduced in ''[[The Game Chambers of Questal]]'', a [[1990]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[David R. Deitrick]] and [[Jeff McElroy]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Questal" /> [[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee|''Refugee'']], [[Sean Williams]] and [[Shane Dix]]'s [[2003]] second installment of the [[Force Heretic trilogy|''Force Heretic'' trilogy]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' novel series, later introduced the alternate spelling "memory disk."<ref name="Refugee" />
